scene.s: Six powerful applications unified into one seamless platform — from dashboards to data pipelines to agentic solutions, all powered by Aiden, your DART AI intelligence agent.
Ask Aiden how to get started…
Access specialised tools for every aspect of your data journey, all from one seamless platform.
The control hub for all your data analytics and reporting needs. Build dashboards, create reports and unlock insights with AI.
Automatically generate comprehensive documentation, meeting notes and knowledge bases from your data and conversations.
Discover patterns, explore data relationships and uncover hidden insights across all your data sources.
Machine learning and predictive modelling. Forecast trends, detect anomalies and predict outcomes with AI.
Advanced data transformation and pipeline orchestration. Turn raw data into actionable insights automatically.
